name: What does the storm damage roof evaluation process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does the storm damage roof evaluation process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The storm damage roof evaluation process involves a detailed inspection of your roof's exterior and, if accessible, its attic components. Our technicians will examine shingles for bruising, cracking, or loss of granules; check for missing or damaged flashing; inspect gutters for dents or detachment; and assess the overall integrity of the roof structure. We document all findings with photographs and a written report, which can be essential for your insurance claim. This comprehensive approach ensures all affected areas are identified.
acceptedAnswer.description: The evaluation process includes a detailed inspection of your roof's exterior and attic, documenting all damage with photos and a report for insurance.
